card.name: Pronoun right after the verb tell
card.fires_on: The object pronoun (me, us, you) straight after the verb "tell", usually before what is being told, as in "Tell us about" or "can tell you".

modes.label: Request to tell
modes.description: An interviewer or page asks the reader or guest to tell them something.
modes.example: Host: Tell<< me>> about what the Molecular Imaging Center itself is

modes.label: Something that tells us
modes.description: A thing or finding is said to tell someone something.
modes.example: And those signals can tell<< us>> something about the metabolism and the gene expression
